name: Deep Work
description: Music for working, reading and thinking: quiet dynamics, long chord cycles, gentle ambient beds and seeded, generative parts that never repeat in quite the same way. Each piece is a complete form of three to eight minutes. It eases in, develops through sections and slows into a real ending, so you can use it to time a block of work. Noise Shelter loops for as long as you need it. Nothing sudden, nothing that asks for your attention. Change the Seed box for a fresh take.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Library Hours
sketches.description: The hush of a big reading room: a slow clock, warm chords that swell in and fade away, and a sparse piano that never plays the same phrase twice. A quiet lull sits between two reading sections. About five minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)
song("intro@8 reading@24 lull@8 reading'@24 outro@8", "once")
tempomap("0:15 64:15 72:12")

// The hush of a big reading room: soft brown noise and a slow clock
air: s("brown").slow(8).lpf(600).gain(.08)
clock: s("tick*2").lpf(4000).pan(.7).gain(.1)

// Sparse piano: a few seeded notes from the pentatonic, never the same twice.
// It plays only while reading; the primed section draws a fresh set of phrases.
piano: n(irand(8).segment(4)).scale("D:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.5).seed("library")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(1.2).sustain(.1).release(1.5)
  .room(.6).size(.8).gain(.28)
  .sections("reading")

// Warm chords, two bars each: Fmaj7, Dm9, Bbmaj7, Cadd9.
// One long swell over the whole piece: in through the intro, away in the outro.
chords: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [d3,f3,a3,e4] [bb2,d3,f3,a3] [c3,e3,g3,d4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(2)
  .attack(1).release(3).lpf(1400).room(.7)
  .gain(env("0 .2@6 0", "song"))

// Now and then a chair creaks in the next aisle, clearer in the lull
chair: s("~ ~ ~ creak").mask("<0 0 1 0 0 0 0 1>").occlude(.5)
  .gain(bysec("lull:.16 *:.12"))

sketches.name: Deep Focus
sketches.description: A filtered brown-noise bed and a low fifth that barely moves. A pad opens and closes through two long deep sections, a distant bell marks every sixteen bars, and everything settles back to noise at the end. About seven and a half minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(50/4)
song("settle@16 deep@32 deep'@32 surface@16", "once")

// Brown noise, gently filtered so it never hisses
noise: s("brown").slow(8).lpf(sine.range(300, 700).slow(32)).gain(.18)

// A low open fifth that barely moves, rising out of the noise and sinking back
drone: note("<[c2,g2] [c2,g2] [ab1,eb2] [bb1,f2]>").slow(4)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.15)
  .lpf(500).attack(4).sustain(1).release(6)
  .gain(env("0 .18@8 0", "song"))

// A wide pad that opens and closes once through every section
pad: note("<[eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [eb3,g3,c4,d4] [c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [d3,f3,bb3,c4]>").slow(4)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
  .lpf(env("400 1400 500", "section")).attack(4).release(6)
  .room(.8).size(.95).gain(.12)
  .exceptSections("settle")

// A distant bell every sixteen bars, only in the deep sections
bell: note("<g4 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(3).fmh(2.76)
  .decay(5).sustain(0).release(5).room(.9).size(.95).gain(.1)
  .sections("deep")

sketches.name: Café Corner
sketches.description: A corner table: the murmur of the room, a brushed and swung kit, jazz voicings, a walking bass and a vibraphone that leaves plenty of space. It plays the head twice, with a turnaround the first time and a stretch of solos the second, then a last head an octave lower and a slow tag. About three and a half minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)
song("intro@4 (head@16 1.turn@4 2.solos@16)*2 head'@16 outro@4", "once")
tempomap("0:21 72:21 76:18")

// The murmur of a café
crowd: s("crowd").slow(8).intensity(.3).gain(.12)

// Brushed kit, lazily swung and rolled off; a soft brush fill closes each section
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd, ~ rim ~ rim, hh*8").swing(4).lpf(4000)
  .gain(bysec("solos:.42 *:.38"))
  .exceptSections("intro outro").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))

// Jazz piano voicings: Dm9, G13, Cmaj9, A7
keys: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [f3,b3,e4,a4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [g3,c#4,e4,g4]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ [~ x] ~ x ~ ~")
  .s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2)
  .decay(.8).sustain(.3).release(.6).lpf(2400).room(.4).gain(.28)

// Walking upright bass, in after the piano intro
bass: note("<[d2 f2 a2 c3] [g1 b1 d2 f2] [c2 e2 g2 b2] [a1 c#2 e2 g2]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.15).gain(.48)
  .exceptSections("intro")

// A vibraphone wandering the changes, forgetting a note now and then.
// It sits out the turnaround and drops an octave for the last head.
vibes: n("~ [4 ~ 2] ~ 1 ~ ~ [0 2] ~").scale("D:dorian").transpose(12)
  .every(3, rev).degradeBy(.3).seed("cafe")
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(4).decay(.6).sustain(0).release(.8)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.2)
  .sections("head solos").variant(x => x.transpose(-12))

sketches.name: Rain on the Skylight
sketches.description: Steady rain and stray drips overhead. A felt piano rolls slow broken chords, first alone and then with a cello holding the roots. In a short bridge the cello is left alone with the rain, then the piano returns an octave higher before a slow close. Over four minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(64/4)
song("intro@4 alone@16 duet@16 bridge@8 duet'@16 outro@8", "once")
tempomap("0:16 60:16 68:12")

// Rain overhead and a few drips nearby
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.5).gain(.3)
drips: s("drip*8?0.7").pan(rand).gain(rand.range(.05, .15)).space("room")

// Felt piano: slow broken chords through Am, F, C, G.
// It rests in the bridge and comes back an octave higher.
piano: note("<[a2 e3 a3 c4 e4 c4 a3 e3] [f2 c3 f3 a3 c4 a3 f3 c3] [c3 g3 c4 e4 g4 e4 c4 g3] [g2 d3 g3 b3 d4 b3 g3 d3]>").slow(2)
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.01).decay(1).sustain(.1).release(1.4)
  .lpf(1600).room(.6).size(.8).gain(.3)
  .sections("alone duet outro").variant(x => x.transpose(12).gain(.22))

// A cello holds the roots once the duet begins
cello: note("<a2 f2 c3 g2>").slow(2).s("sawtooth").vib(4.5).vibdepth(.08)
  .lpf(700).attack(.8).sustain(.7).release(1.5).room(.5).gain(.18)
  .sections("duet bridge outro")

sketches.name: Fireside Reading
sketches.description: A crackling fire, folk guitar picking in G, a low cello, a mantel clock and a distant whistle that comes and goes. The verse is played twice, with the guitar alone by the embers in between, then a last verse with a lower whistle and a slow close. About four minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(70/4)
song("kindling@4 (verse@16 1.ember@4 2.ember'@8)*2 verse'@16 outro@8", "once")
tempomap("0:17.5 64:17.5 72:14")

// The fire
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.4).density(10).gain(.3)

// Guitar picking a slow folk pattern: G, Em, C, D. Softer by the embers.
guitar: note("<[g2 d3 g3 b3 d4 b3 g3 d3] [e2 b2 e3 g3 b3 g3 e3 b2] [c3 g3 c4 e4 g4 e4 c4 g3] [d3 a3 d4 f#4 a4 f#4 d4 a3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .attack(.002).decay(.5).sustain(0).release(.5)
  .lpf(2600).pan(.4).room(.4)
  .gain(bysec("ember:.22 *:.3"))
  .exceptSections("kindling")

// A low cello under the guitar in the verses and the close
cello: note("<g2 e2 c2 d2>").s("sawtooth").vib(4.5).vibdepth(.08)
  .lpf(600).attack(.6).sustain(.6).release(1.2).room(.5).gain(.18)
  .sections("verse outro")

// A soft whistle, far away, every other phrase of a verse; lower in the last one
whistle: note("<[d5@3 b4] [g4@4] [e5@2 d5 c5] [a4@4]>").mask("<0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.2).sustain(.6).release(1).pan(.65).room(.6).gain(.16)
  .sections("verse").variant(x => x.transpose(-12))

// The clock on the mantelpiece
clock: s("tick ~ tick ~").pan(.25).gain(.08)

sketches.name: Tidal Writing
sketches.description: A desk by the sea: surf and a light wind, a pad that rises and falls like the swell, a glassy motif in the echoes and a far-off gull. Three swells with a calm between them, each one a little different, then the tide goes out. About five minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(56/4)
song("shore@8 swell@16 swell'@16 calm@8 swell''@16 ebb@8", "once")
tempomap("0:14 64:14 72:11")

// Waves and a light wind that picks up in the calm
surf: s("surf").slow(8).intensity(.4).gain(.3)
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.2).gain(bysec("calm:.1 *:.06"))

// A slow pad in D, rising and falling like the swell
pad: note("<[d3,a3,e4,f#4] [b2,f#3,d4,a4] [g2,d3,b3,f#4] [a2,e3,c#4,e4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .lpf(sine.range(500, 1600).slow(16)).attack(2).release(4)
  .room(.8).size(.9).gain(.14)
  .exceptSections("shore")

// A glassy motif drifting through the echoes: longer echoes on the second swell,
// an octave lower on the third
glass: n("<[0 ~ 4 ~] [~ 2 ~ ~] [7 ~ ~ 4] [~ ~ 2 ~]>").scale("D:major").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.5).sustain(0).release(1)
  .pan(sine.slow(8)).delay(.45).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.5).room(.6).gain(.2)
  .sections("swell").variant(x => x.delayfeedback(.65), x => x.transpose(-12))

// A gull, far off to the left
gull: s("bird").slow(4).azimuth(-70).distance(8).gain(.12)

sketches.name: Thought Garden
sketches.description: Generative piano over a soft held fifth: two hands improvise from the same pentatonic scale, each with its own seed. The left hand starts alone, the right hand joins, and each new section draws new phrases. They pause, talk once more and slow to a close. Change the seed for a new take. About five minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)
song("ground@4 alone@8 talk@24 talk'@24 pause@8 talk''@16 coda@8", "once")
tempomap("0:18 84:18 92:14")

// Two hands improvise from the same scale, each with its own seed.
// Every primed section is a freshly seeded conversation.
right: n(irand(10).segment(8)).scale("E:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.55).seed("think-1")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(1).sustain(.05).release(1.2)
  .pan(.6).room(.6).size(.8).gain(.26)
  .sections("talk coda")
left: n(irand(5).segment(2)).scale("E:minor pentatonic").transpose(-12)
  .degradeBy(.3).seed("think-2")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(1.5).sustain(.1).release(1.5)
  .pan(.4).room(.6).size(.8).gain(.24)
  .exceptSections("ground")

// A soft held fifth keeps the key
drone: note("[e2,b2]").slow(8).s("sine").attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.15)

sketches.name: Flow State
sketches.description: A soft, steady beat for heads-down work: a muted kick, drifting hats, a round bass and a delayed arpeggio over Am, F, C, G, two bars each. Two long flow sections are separated by a short beatless pause, and the piece eases out without the kit. About four minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(90/4)
song("intro@8 flow@32 pause@8 flow'@32 outro@8", "once")
tempomap("0:22.5 80:22.5 88:18")

// A soft, steady kit way back in the mix, only in the flow sections
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~").lpf(200).gain(.5),
  s("~ ~ rim ~").room(.3).gain(.18),
  s("hh*8").hpf(8000).gain(perlin.range(.05, .15))
).exceptSections("intro pause outro")

// Round bass on the roots, two bars per chord
bass: note("<a1 f1 c2 g1>").slow(2).struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sine").shape(.1).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.2).gain(.45)
  .exceptSections("intro")

// An arpeggio in the delay keeps time without asking for attention;
// a rounder pulse width in the second flow
arp: n("[0 2 4 2]*2").add("<0 0 5 5 2 2 6 6>").scale("A:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.3).lpf(1600).decay(.1).sustain(0)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.35).gain(.1)
  .exceptSections("outro").variant(x => x.pw(.5))

// A pad holding the chords, one gentle arc over the whole piece
pad: note("<[a3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4] [c4,e4,g4] [g3,b3,d4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .attack(1).release(2).lpf(1200).room(.6)
  .gain(env("0 .14@10 .04", "song"))

sketches.name: Midnight Terminal
sketches.description: Late-night coding: a slow filtered sequence in C minor, a deep pad and sub, a quiet kit and the hum of the server room behind you. The hum is louder as the machines boot and shut down. The drums drop out for a debugging stretch, then return with a sharper sequence. About five minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(80/4)
song("boot@8 compile@32 debug@16 compile'@32 shutdown@8", "once")
tempomap("0:20 88:20 96:16")

// A quiet electronic kit, only while compiling
drums: s("bd ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~, [~ hh]*4").lpf(3000).room(.3).gain(.32)
  .exceptSections("boot debug shutdown")

// A slow sequence through Cm, Ab, Fm, Gm, two bars each; more resonant the second time
seq: n("0 2 4 2 7 4 2 4").add("<0 0 -2 -2 -4 -4 -3 -3>").scale("C:minor")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(500, 1800).slow(16)).lpq(4).decay(.15).sustain(0)
  .pan(.4).delay(.35).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.4).gain(.15)
  .sections("compile debug").variant(x => x.lpq(8))

// A deep pad and sub bass
pad: note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
  .attack(2).release(3).lpf(1000).room(.8).size(.9).gain(.14)
sub: note("<c2 ab1 f1 g1>").slow(2).s("sine").attack(.5).sustain(.8).release(1).gain(.35)
  .exceptSections("boot")

// The hum of the server room, somewhere behind you, louder at boot and shutdown
hum: s("engine").slow(8).azimuth(180).distance(5)
  .gain(bysec("boot:.16 shutdown:.16 *:.1"))

sketches.name: Thinking in Circles
sketches.description: Three marimba figures of five, six and seven notes share one step size, so they only line up again every 210 steps. They enter one by one over two slow string chords, turn together in a long middle section, then leave one by one. About three and a half minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)
song("solo@8 duo@8 trio@40 duo'@8 solo'@8", "once")
tempomap("0:24 64:24 72:20")

// Figures of five, six and seven notes share one step size,
// so they line up again only every 210 steps.
// Each section restarts them together, so they always set off in phase.
m1: note("{a3 c4 e4 g4 e4}%8").s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(4).decay(.35).sustain(0)
  .pan(.3).room(.4).gain(.22)
  .sections("solo duo trio")
m2: note("{e4 g4 a4 c5 a4 g4}%8").s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(4).decay(.35).sustain(0)
  .pan(.7).room(.4).gain(.18)
  .sections("duo trio")
m3: note("{c5 ~ d5 e5 ~ g5 ~}%8").s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(4).decay(.3).sustain(0)
  .room(.5).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.13)
  .sections("trio")

// Low strings on two slow chords, with a bass under the full trio
strings: note("<[a2,e3,c4] [f2,c3,a3]>").slow(4)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15).lpf(900)
  .attack(2).release(3).room(.6).gain(.14)
  .exceptSections("solo")
bass: note("<a1 f1>").slow(4).s("sine").attack(.5).sustain(.8).release(1).gain(.3)
  .sections("trio")

sketches.name: Night Train
sketches.description: A book on a night train: the engine rumble, wheels over rail joints, rain on the window and an electric piano watching the lights go by. The train goes through a tunnel and later stops at a quiet station, then the last stretch slows into the terminus. About four minutes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(76/4)
song("depart@4 (journey@16 1.tunnel@4 2.station@8)*2 journey'@16 arrive@8", "once")
tempomap("0:19 64:19 72:15")

// The carriage: a low rumble, loud in the tunnel and idling at the station
engine: s("engine").slow(8).lpf(800).gain(bysec("tunnel:.25 station:.06 *:.15"))
// Wheels over rail joints, silent while the train stands
rails: s("[lt ~ lt ~] ~ ~ ~").speed(.8).lpf(400).gain(.25)
  .exceptSections("station")

// Rain streaking the window, heard through the glass, gone in the tunnel
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.25).occlude(.6).gain(.18)
  .exceptSections("tunnel")

// Electric piano: Ebmaj7, Cm9, Abmaj7, Bb6
keys: note("<[eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [c3,eb3,g3,d4] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3,g3]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~")
  .s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2)
  .decay(1).sustain(.3).release(1).lpf(2000).room(.5).gain(.28)
  .exceptSections("depart tunnel")

// Bass, and a passing melody that comes and goes on the journey,
// an octave lower on the last stretch
bass: note("<eb2 c2 ab1 bb1>").s("sine").shape(.1).decay(.6).sustain(.4).release(.4).gain(.45)
  .exceptSections("depart")
melody: n("<[4@3 2] [3@2 2 1] [0@4] [1 2 4@2]>").scale("C:minor").transpose(12)
  .mask("<1 1 1 1 0 0 0 0>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.5).sustain(.2).release(1)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.2)
  .sections("journey").variant(x => x.transpose(-12))

sketches.name: Noise Shelter
sketches.description: Nothing tonal at all: brown and pink noise drifting slowly under rain that alternates between lighter and heavier, so the ear never fixes on one sound. A wall against open-plan chatter. It loops for as long as you need it, about four minutes per cycle.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)
song("light@32 heavier@32", "loop")

// Three colours of noise, each drifting slowly so the ear never fixes on one
brown: s("brown").slow(8).lpf(sine.range(250, 600).slow(40)).gain(.22)
pink: s("pink").slow(8).hpf(200).lpf(sine.range(800, 2000).slow(56)).pan(sine.slow(30)).gain(.06)
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.2).gain(bysec("light:.12 heavier:.16"))
